items.title: Guimaraes arrives in Spain to join Newcastle training camp
items.description: Arsenal target Bruno Guimaraes is on his way to meet up with Newcastle United at their pre-season camp in Spain.

items.title: USA cricketer Akhilesh Reddy given eight-year ban under anti-corruption code
items.description: USA cricketer Bodugum Akhilesh Reddy has been banned from all cricket for eight years by the ICC after being found guilty of three counts of breaking anti-corruption rules by a tribunal.

items.title: Tzolis unfazed by Vini Jr rumours as fitness champion settles into Arsenal
items.description: At Arsenal, there is an excitement about whether Vinicius Jr could sign this summer. But on Saturday, they were given a decent reminder that Christos Tzolis now plays for the club on the left wing.

items.title: Celtic drawn against LASK in Champions League play-off
items.description: Celtic will play against Austrian champions LASK in the Champions League play-off round as four other Scottish sides await Europa League and Conference League draws.

items.title: Fukofuka departs Scotland Women head coach role
items.description: Scottish Rugby has announced the departure of women's head coach Sione Fukofuka due to personal reasons after eight months in charge.

items.title: 'Made of muscles!' Why PSG want Japan goalkeeper Suzuki
items.description: Having been linked with a move to the Premier League, Zion Suzuki is set for a switch to European champions Paris Saint-German instead. It marks the completion of the 23-year-old Japanese goalkeeper's rise to the game's summit after a stellar World Cup.

items.description: The Football Association is set to withdraw support for FIFA president Gianni Infantino.

items.title: Aston Villa set-piece guru MacPhee joins Chelsea

items.title: Newcastle sign goalkeeper Hornicek
